title: Social Media Manager & Content Creator
description:
**Company:** JRM Export Private Limited  
**Brand:** hepn  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-time

About hepn

hepn is a growing consumer food brand focused on making healthier everyday food choices more accessible without compromising on taste.

We are looking for a **creative, hands-on Social Media Manager & Content Creator** who can help us build a strong and distinctive brand presence across Instagram and other digital platforms.

This is not a role where you will simply schedule posts or follow a predefined content calendar.

We want someone who can **think of ideas, create content, shoot videos, write scripts/captions, edit reels, design creatives, follow trends and continuously experiment with new ways to grow the brand.**

What You'll Do

* Develop creative content ideas for Instagram, Reels, Stories and other social platforms
* Plan and manage hepn's monthly and weekly content calendar
* Write engaging captions, scripts, hooks and social media copy
* Shoot high-quality product, lifestyle and social media content
* Edit short-form videos and Reels
* Create social media posts, stories and creatives using Canva or similar tools
* Come up with interesting campaigns, concepts, trends and content series for the brand
* Turn simple brand/product ideas into engaging social media content
* Stay updated with Instagram trends, memes, audio trends and emerging content formats
* Coordinate product shoots and create content around launches, offers, events and campaigns
* Engage with the audience through comments, DMs and community-oriented content
* Monitor content performance and understand what type of content is working
* Experiment with different hooks, formats, storytelling styles and creative concepts
* Work closely with the founders/team to develop HEPN's overall social media personality

Skills We're Looking For

You should be comfortable with most of the following:

* **Content Writing & Copywriting**
* **Reels / Short-form Video Editing**
* **Basic Photography & Videography**
* **Content Shooting using a smartphone/camera**
* **Canva Designing**
* Instagram content creation
* Storytelling and script writing
* Understanding of social media trends
* Basic social media analytics
* Strong visual and creative sense

Experience with tools such as **Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Photoshop or similar tools** is an advantage.

Bonus Skills

These are not mandatory, but will be a major plus:

* Meta Ads / Facebook & Instagram Advertising
* Google Ads
* Influencer marketing
* Performance marketing
* SEO / digital marketing knowledge
* Experience working with D2C, FMCG, food or lifestyle brands
* Experience managing brand collaborations
* Understanding of e-commerce marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

* **Highly creative and full of ideas**
* Comfortable experimenting instead of simply copying competitors
* Someone who naturally notices interesting content, trends and campaigns
* Able to take an idea from **concept → script → shoot → edit → publish**
* Comfortable appearing behind or occasionally in front of the camera when required
* Detail-oriented about how content looks and feels
* Fast-moving and able to create content consistently
* Interested in building a brand, not just managing a social media account
* Proactive—you should be able to come to us with ideas rather than always waiting for instructions

You don't necessarily need many years of experience.

**A strong portfolio, creativity and the ability to actually create good content matter more to us than the number of years on your resume.**

What We'd Like to See When You Apply

Please share:

* Your resume
* Instagram/social media accounts you have managed
* Reels/videos you have created
* Designs or Canva creatives you have made
* Any campaigns, brands or personal content you are proud of

**Bonus:** Tell us 2–3 content ideas you would create for hepn if you joined us.

We are looking for someone who wants to **experiment, create and help build a memorable consumer brand from the ground up.**

Website: https://hepn.in

description:
"DHARTI Sing tel" is a heritage edible-oil brand from Ahmedabad, with roots going back to before its 1960 trademark registration. Mention “DHARTI SING TEL” to someone over the age of 45 who was born and raised in Ahmedabad and has spent most of their life here, and you may see something shift immediately: recognition, memory, a sense of home.  
The brand is now being relaunched as a modern, premium consumer business with a direct-to-consumer approach and a strong focus on product quality, customer experience and intelligent growth.  
Working directly with the fifth-generation promoter, you’ll help shape DHARTI’s identity, build anticipation before launch and acquire its first customers.

Your mandate

Build a distinctive brand identity, bring it to market and establish a repeatable approach to customer acquisition. Priorities will evolve with the business, guided by market opportunities, customer insights and results.

What you’ll do

\* Research & strategy: Research the market, competitors and audience; develop brand positioning, storytelling and communication that distinguish DHARTI from conventional edible-oil brands.

\* Pre-launch marketing: Create and execute original social media campaigns that build awareness, curiosity and anticipation around DHARTI’s return.

\* Creative execution: Develop campaign concepts and independently create content, including Reels, Stories, posts, photography and marketing assets.

\* Launch & acquisition: Plan and execute the launch campaign, acquiring early customers in Ahmedabad through digital marketing, sampling, referrals and relevant local initiatives.

\* Growth & retention: Track marketing expenditure, enquiries, conversions and acquisition sources. Use results to improve performance and develop repeat-purchase and referral campaigns.

Who we’re looking for

\* Relevant experience, strong creative judgement, original thinking and a portfolio that demonstrates your contribution.

\* Ability to research, conceptualise, create and execute independently.

\* Understanding of branding, social media, customer acquisition and basic marketing analytics.

\* Commercial curiosity, resourcefulness and the confidence to take initiative.

Gujarati and Hindi proficiency are valuable; strong English communication is preferred. FMCG, food or D2C experience is an advantage.

The role:

This is not simply a social media management or strategy role. You’ll own the work from research and ideation through creation, execution and evaluation.

You’ll work independently, propose ideas, challenge assumptions constructively and collaborate directly with the promoter. You don’t need to be an expert in every creative discipline, but you must be able to turn ideas into finished work.

Why DHARTI?

Help rebuild an Ahmedabad heritage brand for a new generation, with meaningful creative ownership and direct involvement in shaping the business.

description:
**About the role\- https://highadvocacy.com/**
----------------------------------------------

**HighAdvocacy** is hiring its first marketing person. Your job is to take our website from where it is today to 10,000\+ qualified monthly visitors in the next six months.


You'll get there through earned channels: blog posts that rank on Google, a real LinkedIn cadence on the company page and on the founder's personal one, Reddit and X threads where our buyers hang out, and one or two channels you'll find by testing a handful.


For the first 60 days, Piyush (our co\-founder) works alongside you. He'll review drafts, help you build a point of view, and give real feedback. After that, you start making the channel calls. By month six, you're the marketing brain of the company and Piyush is reviewing your decisions, not making them.


This is a full\-time, in\-office role in Ahmedabad. You report directly to Piyush. There's no agency next to you, no senior marketer above you, and no playbook on a shared drive. The brand voice on the internet six months from now will largely be the one you ship.

**What you'll actually be doing**
---------------------------------


Your weekly rhythm looks like this:

* Write 2\-4 blog posts a week for HighAdvocacy.com. Useful enough to rank on Google, honest enough to share.
* Run a 5x/week LinkedIn cadence on the company page. Collaborate with Piyush on posts from his personal profile.
* Find 15\-20 conversations a week on Reddit, X, and LinkedIn where our ICP is asking real questions. Reply like a human, not a brand account.
* Live inside Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Plausible. Use them to debug what's working, not to confirm what you already believe.
* Test one new channel every month: a newsletter swap, a podcast appearance, a community partnership. Be honest about whether it's worth continuing.
* Ship a short dashboard every Friday. What went out, what moved, what you're trying next.
* Build a small library of templates, post formats, and frameworks the next hire can pick up.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


We'll measure progress against these checkpoints together:

**First 30 days** \- 4 blog posts shipped, a LinkedIn cadence running 5x/week, and 15\+ thoughtful Reddit or X comments out in the wild.

**First 90 days** \- You've tested SEO, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, and one community channel. You bring a written recommendation on which 1\-2 channels deserve 70% of your time, defended in a Friday review.

**3 months** \- 5,000 qualified monthly visitors. At least one channel running on autopilot, without Piyush reviewing every piece of output.

**6 months** \- 10,000 qualified monthly visitors. Compounding output across two channels. You're making channel\-level decisions with light founder review.

**How we think about AI in this role**
--------------------------------------


We expect you to use AI every day. The difference we care about is using it as leverage versus using it as a crutch.


Here's how we actually use these tools:

**Claude or ChatGPT** \- Drafting blog outlines, ideating angles, rewriting weak sections, testing your thinking, summarizing competitor content.

**Perplexity** \- Fast research, finding sources and statistics, sanity\-checking claims before publishing.

**Ahrefs AI features** \- Keyword clustering, content gap analysis, surfacing backlink prospects.

**AI for repurposing** \- Turning one blog into a LinkedIn post, an X thread, and a Reddit reply, without making them sound like the same recycled paragraph.

**Pattern analysis** \- Pulling apart top\-performing posts in our space and figuring out what's actually working.

**Cursor or v0 (bonus)** \- Spinning up small landing page experiments without waiting on a designer.


What we don't want: AI\-generated final copy anyone can spot in three seconds. Your taste and voice ship the final draft. AI gets you to about 60% of the work, faster. The last 40%, the part that makes it sound human, is on you.

**Who we're hoping applies**
----------------------------


The best signal for this role isn't years of experience or a degree. It's whether you live on the internet and pay attention to how things land.


This role is probably right for you if a few of these are true:

* You've drafted a LinkedIn post or a tweet in your head while showering.
* You can name 5 people you follow on X and explain why for each.
* You read the comments under good LinkedIn posts to figure out why they worked.
* You'd rather ship 50 honest LinkedIn posts than 1 polished case study that took a month to approve.
* You think most B2B SaaS marketing reads like the same paragraph copy\-pasted across the internet, and you can point at examples.
* You've shipped something publicly on your own time: a blog, an X account, a side project, a newsletter. Audience size doesn't matter. The shipping does.
* You use AI to move faster through the boring parts, not to think for you.

**Who probably shouldn't apply**
--------------------------------


Skip this role if any of these feel true:

* You need a playbook handed to you before you can start.
* The first thing on your resume is "HubSpot Certified" or a marketing degree.
* You haven't shipped anything publicly outside a job you were paid for.
* You find Ahrefs intimidating and don't want to learn it.
* You're hoping someone else (an agency, a senior, the founder) does the work and you review it.

**What we're not asking for**
-----------------------------


None of these are required. Don't filter yourself out if you don't have them:

* Prior B2B SaaS experience. You'll pick up the context in two weeks.
* SEO certifications. Ahrefs and a few good blogs will teach you more in a month.
* Paid ads experience. Out of scope for this role.
* Video or design skills. Not what we need here.
* HubSpot, Marketo, or any specific automation tool. We don't use them.
* An MBA or a marketing degree. Irrelevant at this level.

**Logistics**
-------------

* Experience: 1\-2 years of marketing at a startup or agency.
* Location: Full\-time, in\-office, Ahmedabad.
* Reports to: Piyush, Co\-founder.
* Compensation: Based on your experience and portfolio. We'll be straight about ranges on the first call.
* Bonus: A personal blog or newsletter, an active X profile (any size), B2B SaaS exposure, or light video skills.
